Question: Which parts have the largest total quantity ordered? Give the top ten part names with their quantities.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  p.p_name,
  SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM samples.tpch.lineitem l
JOIN samples.tpch.part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
GROUP BY p.p_name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 10
